$comment: Synthetic leak-gate parity fixtures shared by the TypeScript scanner (tests/unit/leak-gate-parity.test.ts) and the SQL gate (supabase/tests/database/leak_gate_parity.test.sql, generated by `npm run db:gen-leak-parity`). Every organisation, place, reference, postcode and date is invented. Never add real buyer, supplier, place, project or notice strings.

deal.sourceDescription: Supply and maintenance of six winter gritting vehicles with insulated hoppers and route telematics for the Kelderwick depot. Vehicles must report to the QVRS fleet portal. Brindlequay will hold the reserve salt. Tolvercombe crews handle night shifts. OSKERNAITH SALT STORE - LOT 2.
